sources.adaptation: Original oxidised camera case, retaining brackets, rivets, piston chains, ribbed actuator and segmented pale parabolic mirror
Exactly three independent support chains and a compact low housing for the evade-and-counter silhouette

authorship.method: Original runtime meshes and deterministic procedural pixel textures; no image crops or sampled source pixels
authorship.source_fidelity_limit: Concept sources supply design vocabulary, not proven mechanical engineering, final runtime art or authored ray timing

native_pixels.texture_structure: Four-pixel oxidation clusters with sparse seam or rubber rib rows
native_pixels.mirror_and_hardware: not_applicable: faceted meshes and muted solid materials

world_scale.units: Shared world metres at root scale 1
world_scale.measurement_status: Analytical intended dimensions and sampled all-yaw support/mirror bounds. Revised mesh silhouette and low-housing occlusion still require parent portrait recapture
world_scale.travel_and_reach: Cosmetic pose cannot move the actor root, alter collider size or change attack range

pivots.root_meaning: Ground-level XZ attack source and feet anchor; parent owns its logical hit point and all movement
pivots.foot_contact: Foot-box lower faces lie at local Y=0; each foot stays fixed during planted and collapse poses
pivots.facing: Local +Z mirror forward. Supplied world planar direction is transformed through the visual root's global basis; upright uniform-scale actor roots are expected
pivots.mirror_articulation: Warning/lock mirror is elevated and forward of the case; paired saddle links connect its hinge to the case. Recovery/defeat retract the hinge before the folded pose, without moving the root or low housing

palette_role.body: Muted black, dark rust and oxidised grey plate with restrained brass hardware
palette_role.mirror: Four pale polished mesh segments, dark retaining rim and visible clips. A physical dark cover closes the central idle aperture and retracts on the first warning pose call
palette_role.housing: Dark physical doors reveal a pale low coupler only in recovery or collapse
palette_role.cue_policy: No floor warning, halo, available-state marker or ray drawn here. The parent attaches shared cue components

collision_occlusion.attack_point_count: Parent owns one logical low-housing attack point; the three supports and mirror are never separate targets
collision_occlusion.depth_test: normal depth testing; no through-wall effect
collision_occlusion.shadows: Mesh shadow casting disabled; parent may attach shared grounded contact presentation
collision_occlusion.occlusion: Compact raised rig is ordinary opaque geometry. Feet, housing, player and shared lane must be reviewed together in portrait

api.pose: pose(phase: String, progress: float, direction: Vector3, hit_flash: bool = false) -> void
api.progress: Normalized parent phase clock, clamped to [0,1]; nonfinite progress becomes zero
api.direction: World planar direction. Invalid or zero inputs retain the last valid direction. Mirror yaw follows every supplied valid direction; parent supplies immutable direction during lock/active
api.pre_ready_calls: Requested pose is retained and applied after _ready
api.snapshot: Parent restores its authoritative phase, progress, direction and flash then calls pose. Latched support yaw is cosmetic and can be reconstructed at restored phase entry

states.pose: Compact upright camera case, closed low housing and partly stowed mirror with physical dark aperture cover; body follows supplied direction
Same covered compact pose; parent owns translation and clocks
Support heading plants on phase entry; physical cover retracts immediately and the exposed mirror tracks direction while tilting from -0.40 to -0.24 radians
Held planted supports, fully level exposed bright mirror, closed low housing and fixed parent direction
Held level mirror with tiny physical shutter release and cosmetic case recoil; no beam or damage
Immediate retracted-and-folded mirror at forward Z=0.30 and open housing doors reveal the low coupler; feet remain grounded for the full parent recovery
Decisive lowered tilted case, bent knees, retracted folded mirror and partly open spent housing; foot contacts stay fixed
Externally supplied boolean applies restrained material emission per instance; no own duration or effect lifetime

duration_clock_owner.seconds: not_applicable: this asset assigns no attack, reaction, recovery or hit-flash duration
duration_clock_owner.phase_entry: Lock, active, recovery and defeated enter decisive readable poses on the first parent pose call
duration_clock_owner.pause: No pose advances unless the parent supplies a new normalized phase sample

reuse.instance_state: Each rig owns its mesh resources, material flash state, phase request and cosmetic planted heading
reuse.shared_systems: Controller, warning geometry, threat scheduler, damage, cue meanings and actual attack timing remain parent/shared-owned
